tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The agency should have satisfactorily completed 100 of the amount put to tender (i.e Rs 20.95 lakhs) in supply of morning breakfast, cooking and catering services to various State/Central Government, state level organization MNCs or any other reputed organization in a single tenderer in any one/two year of the last five years and a certificate to be enclosed in Performa A of Section XII, to this effect). for one year 10 points and two years 20 points
Annual Turnover should be the cost put to tender (Rs 20.95 Lakhs) in any Two year in the preceding 5 years
